economy.summary: His campaign says he is committed to cutting taxes, reducing energy costs, lowering healthcare costs, and making life more affordable for families and seniors.
economy.short: Supports cutting taxes, reducing energy and healthcare costs.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he supports lowering taxes and fiscally responsible budgeting, and notes he voted to fund public education without raising taxes; he cites endorsements from business groups for his budget record.
taxes.short: Supports lowering taxes and fiscally responsible budgeting.

abortion.summary: In July 2022 he voted for Senate Bill 106, a proposed constitutional amendment stating there is no constitutional right to abortion or to taxpayer-funded abortion.
abortion.short: Voted for 2022 amendment stating no constitutional right to abortion.

education.summary: A former economics and history teacher, he says he has prioritized supporting local schools and voted to fully fund public education at record levels without raising taxes.
education.short: Says he voted to fully fund public education without raising taxes.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says he is working to ensure every Pennsylvanian has access to high-quality, affordable healthcare and prescription drugs.
healthcare.short: Supports access to affordable healthcare and prescription drugs.

energy.summary: His campaign says he opposes excessive warehouse development and truck traffic, supports smart economic growth, and cites reducing energy costs and protecting the environment.
energy.short: Opposes excessive warehouse development; cites reducing energy costs, environment.

guns.summary: In November 2021 he voted for Senate Bill 565, which would allow carrying a concealed firearm without a license.
guns.short: Voted for bill allowing concealed carry without a license.

economy.summary: His campaign says he would hold price-gouging corporations accountable for the cost of essentials, from groceries to housing to health care.
economy.short: Would hold price-gouging corporations accountable for essentials' costs.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he supports ensuring big corporations pay their fair share in taxes and lowering the property tax burden on homeowners through better school funding.
taxes.short: Supports corporations paying fair share; lowering homeowners' property taxes.

education.summary: His campaign says he prioritizes fairly funding local schools to give children better opportunities.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says he wants to ensure all Pennsylvanians have a right to affordable and quality healthcare regardless of race, class, or geographic location.
healthcare.short: Supports affordable, quality healthcare for all Pennsylvanians.

energy.summary: His campaign says he supports preserving as much farmland and open space as possible, continuing work he has done on Northampton County Council.
energy.short: Supports preserving farmland and open space.

guns.summary: On public safety, his campaign says he would ensure police, fire departments, and EMS have the tools they need and provide enhanced mental health resources for schools and the community; the site does not detail a firearms-policy position.
guns.short: Supports funding police, fire, EMS; enhanced community mental health resources.
